method.line_count: UTF-8 LF-delimited physical lines, including a final unterminated line; binary files use null, not zero.
method.analysis: Only reviewed contiguous range annotations permit analyzed status; hashes or text copying do not constitute analysis.
method.binary: Binary files retain null line counts. Analyzed binaries require authored contiguous zero-based half-open byte annotations, semantic inspection evidence and an identical preserved byte artifact; hash equality alone is insufficient.

excluded_directories.reason: Git object database and administrative metadata; commit/status recorded separately.

historical_scope_superseded: Original full-file totals/statuses are preserved only for provenance. Apply CORE-MANIFEST.json and CORE-SCOPE.md for current scope and completion.
